title: Clubhouse Comms

briefings.headline: Hunt the heater; make Rasmussen prove he can land the changeup
briefings.message: Drew Rasmussen is the high-confidence expected starter. Look for fastballs early, but stay selective against his changeup, his best whiff pitch. Yordan Alvarez has the clearest matchup edge at 0.369; Isaac Paredes and Jeremy Peña have even matchups. Against Tampa Bay’s bullpen, be ready for rested Bryan Baker, Tyler Wells, and Cole Sulser.
reminders: Fastball first; do not chase the changeup.
Rasmussen is a high-confidence expectation; Ian Seymour is the alternative.

briefings.headline: Lambert leads; attack the heart of Tampa Bay’s order with intent
briefings.message: Peter Lambert starts, with a 95 pitch-count limit and a 6.0-inning target. Work carefully around Yandy Díaz and avoid predictable breaking balls. Mix breaking pitches to Junior Caminero and keep fastballs out of the heart of the zone. Use rested relievers first: Bryan King and Enyel De Los Santos are high-leverage options; Josh Hader, Bryan Abreu, and Bennett Sousa are limited after pitching yesterday.
reminders: Change speeds and expand off the plate against Jonathan Aranda.
Control Chandler Simpson’s running game; avoid free passes.
If Lambert exits early, use Miguel Ullola for length before bridging with middle relief.
